prior_importants.description: Ranked fix 1 adds a rule to the session prompt's Searching section, which only routes questions to `Explore` subagents (2 of 111); the short-lived waste in cause 1 comes from `general-purpose` subagents (108 of 111), and the ready-to-add task wrongly calls the change a template edit with no code change.

findings.description: The ranked list still sells fix 1 as "About 5 USD per retro window for one line of prompt. This can be a small task". That contradicts the reworded Effort bullet (line 35) and the plan-add blockquote (line 64), which both say the change is code and tests, not a template edit, and that finding the origin of the launches comes first. A reader who skims only the ranked list, which is the ranking they are meant to act on, will still size fix 1 as a one-line prompt tweak. Suggestion: replace "for one line of prompt. This can be a small task" with "for a small code and test change, after finding where the `general-purpose` launches originate".
